citations.assessment: The Bavli identifies Rami bar Tamrei also as Rami bar Dikolei. Ohr Zarua reads bar Dikola in the same episode. The precise force of the name remains open.

evidence.reference: Ohr Zarua, Volume IV, Piskei Avodah Zarah 177:1
